title: QA: flaky test with a table-driven title
summary: A docs-only commit turns CI red; delivery order depends on seeded random jitter (alibi-qa controlled scenario).

failingTest.name: plan delivers notifications in submission order

expected.notes: Seed 4242000 fails. Seeds k*65537 for k=1..6 fail on k=1,2,5,6. The test title comes from data, so no quarantine candidate can be generated: confirmed diagnosis, no validated fix.
